references.title: LEGO Icons Bookstore: Book Nook 11379
references.text: Take time out for a rewarding project with the LEGO Icons Bookstore: Book Nook (11379) building set for adults ages 18 and up. This immersive home decor model makes a perfect gift idea for writers and book lovers. It can be a captivating display on its own or as a bookend on a desk or bookshelf. Place the completed book nook kit between your favorite novels to create a window into a cozy bookstore, or open it up to explore a richly detailed 2-story interior with elegant balconies and a spiral staircase. Discover thoughtful details throughout the build, from the snug authors workspace to quiet reading areas and subtle references to renowned works of literature, including a golden cup, magnifying glass and a black cat statue. The miniature scene also includes minifigures of an author and a reader for enhanced visual storytelling possibilities. Discover a deeper building experience with the LEGO Builder app, where you can zoom in, rotate models in 3D, save sets and track your progress using a digital version of the printed instructions. Explore the inspiring range of LEGO Icons building sets (each sold separately) designed specifically with adult builders in mind. Contains 1,690 pieces.

references.title: Rifle Paper Co. Rifle Paper Ladies Night Book Club Porcelain Mug
references.text: Settle in with a good book and a warm drink. The Ladies Night Book Club Porcelain Mug features a delightful illustration of stacked literary classics, making it a charming companion for book lovers. A gilded rim and handle add an elegant finishing touch. Generously sized to hold 16 ounces, this porcelain mug is perfect for coffee, tea or cocoa enjoyed between chapters. Or you can transform your mug into a pen stand using our Cuppa Pens Converter (available separately).
